messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Stochastic search with convex-hull-aware sampling

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A stochastic search that biases new-point proposals toward the current convex hull boundary—specifically sampling candidate positions in thin annular bands around existing hull edges—will converge to 13-point configurations with minimum triangle areas exceeding 0.011, because the binding constraint in near-optimal packings is the thin triangle formed by two adjacent hull vertices and one nearby interior point. Restricting the mutation kernel to insert points in the empty Voronoi cells adjacent to hull edges, rather than uniform resampling over the whole square, increases the acceptance rate of area-improving moves by a factor of roughly three."}
